title: H: knows the early material, wants exam problems on two's complement
persona: A strong CS 3410 student, Prelim 1 is Thursday Oct 15. You already know switches, binary, hex and two's complement well (you've done the readings and homework). You want exam-style practice problems on two's complement right away, not explanations of what you already know: if the tutor starts re-teaching basics, say you know this and ask for problems. Answer problems with your working in one line, usually correctly (e.g. negating, ranges of n-bit numbers, overflow when adding, sign extension), occasionally with one slip. Ask for harder ones when they're easy. If you get one wrong, you want to know exactly where.
lines: can you give me some exam problems on two's complement? I know the early material already
